messages:
sam-oncall: Weird spike in TLS handshakes failing on eu-central -> us-west after the morning deploy. Rate ~0.6% for 10m. Opening thread to track.

mira-sre: can you dump a couple of traces or example logs?

sam-oncall: added snippet to the incident doc and a short grep: `tls_handshake_error route=eu-central->us-west retries>=2`.

lee-net: looking at LB egress, I see sticky routing kept traffic to a small subset of gateways that show repeated SYN retransmits and reduced MSS in SYN-ACK. Could be PMTU or an intermediate device.

dan-platform: note: the rollout toggled sticky routing to avoid cross-region churn. that may have concentrated load on a path with corrupted MSS options.

mira-sre: action: lee to collect pcaps + traceroute and run a synthetic replay to reproduce. owner=lee-net, ETA=EOD Thu.

lee-net: capturing now; will upload pcap to s3 and paste link. plan: enable tcp_mtu_probing on a single gateway in staging to validate.

infra-bot: INC-5012 created: "sticky-route concentration -> TLS handshake increase" assigned lee-net, mira-sre.

ashley-pm: we need a quick safety gate: if handshake_fail_rate > 0.5% for 10m, trigger rollback of sticky route flag. who owns that?

dan-platform: platform team. I'll create an alert + automated rollback playbook, include runbook link. ETA 48h.

mira-sre: also adding per-route handshake metrics to Console. owner=mira-sre, PR target=next Tue.

lee-net: staging test: enabling `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on the probe gateway improved handshake success from 99.4% -> 99.99% under synthetic. uploaded pcap: s3://redwood-pcaps/1887654321-sticky-pmtu.pcap

dan-platform: wired alert + rollback playbook; playbook will post to #incidents and this thread. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-handshake

mira-sre: proposed follow-ups: 1) short-term patch (enable mtu probing on gateway fleet), 2) dashboard per-route, 3) weekly check-ins for retry patterns for 3 weeks. owners: lee, mira, platform.

sam-oncall: concise action list: lee-net - staging patch + pcap (EOD Thu); dan-platform - alert & rollback automation (48h); mira-sre - per-route metric PR (next Tue) + weekly cadence; ashley-pm - customer comms if needed. Will close after 24h prod stable.

lee-net: rolling out mtu-probing patch to canary now (eu-central-canary) with 5m observation windows.

infra-bot: RDW-412 linked for per-route metrics work.

mira-sre: noted prod stable after 8h. leaving thread open for 24h before close.
